## Problem

What problem does this feature solve? Who is affected and how often?

## Proposed solution

A clear description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative solutions or workarounds you have already considered.

## Additional context

Any mockups, examples from other tools, or references that might help.
